meta.title: DecisionGuard AI — Decision risk intelligence
meta.description: Analyze, anticipate and monitor the risks of your strategic decisions with verified multi-agent AI.

hero.title: Know what could go wrong, before you decide.
hero.subtitle: DecisionGuard AI examines every decision from eight angles — financial, strategic, legal, cyber, human, operational, predictive — then verifies its own conclusions before presenting them.

verified.title: Verified conclusions
verified.body: An independent audit agent checks the consistency, calculations and sources of every analysis.

reproducible.title: Reproducible scores
reproducible.body: Risk scores are computed by a deterministic engine, never improvised by the AI.

transparent.title: Facts ≠ assumptions
transparent.body: Every finding is labelled: verified fact, assumption, estimate or AI-generated hypothesis.

footer.disclaimer: DecisionGuard AI analyses support decision-making. They do not replace professional legal or financial advice.
